description: 同色格象 — 黑方正确防守：象换兵求和

intro.popup_en: Both bishops are light-squared. White wants to exchange bishops and promote the pawn, so Black's main task is to protect the bishop and avoid the exchange to draw.
intro.popup:
♗ 同色格象的攻防
双方象都在浅色格，白方想用象换掉黑象后兵升变。
黑方核心任务：守住象，避免被对换，最终逼和！

outro.popup_en: Draw by repetition. The white bishop returns to c6 three times, while Black avoids the exchange. With same-colored bishops, an extra pawn may not be enough to win if the defender cannot be exchanged.
outro.popup:
🤝 和棋！重复局面
白象三次走回c6，黑方成功躲避对换，局面三次重复 = 和棋。
同色格象若无法兑换，有兵也难赢。

moves.popup_en: The white bishop heads to h5, preparing to help the king pressure the black bishop from the side.
moves.popup: 白象移向h5，准备从侧翼配合白王挤压黑象。

moves.popup_en: The black bishop retreats to avoid being exchanged.
The white bishop tightens the pressure.
The black bishop holds the key diagonal and controls the d7 entry square.
moves.popup: 黑象守住要道，封锁d7入口。

moves.popup_en: The white king approaches the center to support the attack.
moves.popup: 白王向中心靠拢，准备支援。

moves.popup_en: The black king moves toward the center.
The white bishop retreats to prepare an attack from another angle.
moves.popup: 白象回撤，准备换个角度进攻。

moves.popup_en: The black bishop checks while also guarding d7, forcing the white king back.
moves.popup: ⚡ 黑象将军！同时守住d7，让白王被迫后退。

moves.popup_en: The white king steps out of check.
The black bishop returns to its defensive post.
The white king keeps approaching the pawn.
The black king follows to stop the white king from gaining an advantage.
moves.popup: 黑王跟过来，防止白王占优势。

moves.popup_en: The white king pressures the black bishop.
The black bishop maneuvers backward and continues avoiding the exchange.
moves.popup: 黑象机动后退，继续躲避对换。

moves.popup_en: The white king continues the pursuit.
The black bishop returns to defend the d6 area.
The white king circles around but cannot break through.
moves.popup: 白王绕来绕去，无法突破。

moves.popup_en: The black king actively joins the defense.
The white bishop changes position and tries another angle.
moves.popup: 白象换位，再次尝试不同角度。

moves.popup_en: The black bishop slips away to avoid the exchange.
The white bishop returns to c6 for the first time.
The black king responds actively.
The white bishop changes direction and looks for a new breakthrough.
moves.popup: 白象换向，寻找新突破口。

moves.popup_en: The black bishop continues to maneuver flexibly.
The white bishop returns to c6 for the second time.
The black bishop keeps moving, and White still has no breakthrough.
moves.popup: 黑象继续游走，白方找不到突破口。

moves.popup_en: The white bishop tries from another direction.
The black bishop returns to its post and holds comfortably.
The white bishop returns to c6 for the third time. The position has not changed, so Black draws by threefold repetition.
moves.popup: 🔄 第三次重复！和棋。白象三走c6，局面无进展，黑方成功求和。
